title: A Side Project Sold for $2.5 Billion #shorts
description:
In two thousand nine, a Swedish programmer started a block-building game after work. In twenty fourteen, Microsoft bought his studio, Mojang, for two and a half billion dollars.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
hook_text:
ONE MAN'S SIDE PROJECT
SOLD FOR $2.5 BILLION
first_comment: Would you have sold your game for two and a half billion, or kept building it forever? 👇

lines.text: One man's side project sold for two and a half billion dollars.
And it was made of blocks.
In two thousand nine, a Swedish programmer coded a game after work.
No story. Just blocks you could break and build.
He sold early versions online for about ten euros each.
Players spread it by word of mouth. Millions bought it before it was finished.
He quit his job. The game was called Minecraft.
In twenty fourteen, it bought his studio for two and a half billion dollars.
Two and a half billion dollars, for a world made of blocks.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
